summary: This bill extends the prohibition on reducing personnel for military discharge review agencies until 2030 and requires the Department of Defense to report on the time taken to review discharge appeals related to PTSD or traumatic brain injury, including recommendations for expediting these cases.

scores.thoughts: This bill extends a prohibition on reducing personnel for service review agencies and requires a report from the Secretary of Defense regarding discharge reviews. While it touches on military administration, it does not directly increase or decrease overall military spending, but rather focuses on internal processes and reporting related to veterans' discharge reviews.
